mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_car_repair(b_id, repair_id, `date`, content, price, declarant, car_id, operate, community_id) values (#{bId}, #{repairId}, #{date}, #{content}, #{price}, #{declarant}, #{carId}, #{operate}, #{communityId})

insert into pubcar_car_repair(repair_id, date, content, price, declarant, car_id, b_id, community_id, status_cd) select repair_id, date, content, price, declarant, car_id, b_id, community_id, '0' from business_pubcar_car_repair where b_id = #{bId} and operate= #{operate}
